preconditions: Candidate2 gates passed; fresh process connected through launcher to http://127.0.0.1:8082; empty search, All sessions, ten checked tracks, no favorites verified before enabling TalkBack. TalkBack then bound with touch exploration enabled, but permission dialog interrupted.
steps: Enable TalkBack with the two authorized settings commands
Foreground existing MainActivity without permission choice
Attempt search exploration; pre-action target check fails, so no input

observer: Hermes GPT-6.1 Sol high (device actions); pixels pending coordinator
defectOrDecision: BLOCKED environment/authority: human decision required for Accessibility Suite notification prompt or prior onboarding in a separately authorized run; no app defect inferred.
teardown: TalkBack restored via settings delete secure enabled_accessibility_services and settings put secure accessibility_enabled 0; all nine entry values exactly match final reread.
